title: facts.json
description: Curated, source-backed cache of time-sensitive facts (model versions, prices, free-tier limits, specs). The single source of truth for any model/tool/price/version claim: these are verified live against `source`, NEVER recalled from model memory. refresh-facts.mjs only AUDITS staleness (writes a freshness report); it never overwrites a value.

updated.description: ISO date this cache was last hand-curated.

max_age_days.description: A fact older than this (measured from its `retrieved` date) is flagged stale by refresh-facts.mjs and must be re-verified live before it may be used in a script.

rule.description: Human-readable restatement of the live-never-recalled rule.

facts.description: Flat, multi-tagged list of facts (mirrors the idea-bank's flat model).

subject.description: Vendor/tool the fact is about, e.g. anthropic, openai, google.

label.description: Human label of what the value means.

value.description: The fact itself: a version id, a price, a limit.

unit.description: e.g. 'USD per million input tokens', 'requests/day'. null for non-numeric facts.

source.description: Official page this value was verified against.

retrieved.description: ISO date the value was last confirmed live against `source`.
